company.description:
Flowcarbon's versatile team merges investment banking, project finance, tax credit and other financial markets expertise to streamline access to creative capital solutions for the world’s most innovative companies in the infrastructure, decarbonization, and other niche sectors.
Flowcarbon is headquartered in New York, United States and was founded in 2021.
